title: Model-agnostic Knowledge Augmented Machine Learning for Weakly Annotated Bioimaging Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.13637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly used for automated feature extraction from weakly annotated bioimaging data, such as microscopy and cytomorphology images. Due to the sole dependency of automated feature extraction, existing methods yield inconsistent classification performance across weakly annotated datasets. Here, we propose a model-agnostic knowledge augmentation method that enables ML models to exploit domain knowledge beyond what automated feature extraction can capture. The proposed approach improves classification performance across seven ML architectures. When integrated with masked autoencoder-based self-supervised learning, our method achieves the strongest overall performance, improving precision by 2.9% over the next-best method on three in-house microscopy datasets and by an average of 6.8% across three public cytomorphology benchmarks. translated_title: 模型无关的知识增强机器学习用于弱标注生物成像数据
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型日益广泛地被用于从弱标注的生物成像数据（如显微镜和细胞形态学图像）中自动提取特征。然而，由于完全依赖自动特征提取，现有方法在不同弱标注数据集上表现出不一致的分类性能。本文提出了一种模型无关的知识增强方法，使机器学习模型能够利用超出自动特征提取所能捕获范围的领域知识。所提出的方法在七种机器学习架构上均提升了分类性能。当与基于掩码自编码器的自监督学习相结合时，我们的方法取得了最强的整体性能：在三个内部显微镜数据集上，精确率较次优方法提高了2.9%；在三个公开的细胞形态学基准数据集上，精确率平均提高了6.8%。我们基于TAR DNA结合蛋白的错位定位进行了细胞核级别的分类。
tldr: 提出一种模型无关的知识增强方法，通过注入领域知识显著提升弱标注生物成像数据的分类性能，与自监督学习结合时在多个数据集上实现最高6.8%的精确率提升。
en_tdlr: A model-agnostic knowledge augmentation method that injects domain knowledge into ML models to consistently improve classification on weakly annotated bioimaging data, achieving up to 6.8% precision gains when combined with self-supervised learning.
